signup.title: Join the community
signup.lead: Fill in your details in a minute. The club will message you on WhatsApp when there is a game for you.
signup.kioskLead: Sign up after you play. It takes a minute and the club will message you on WhatsApp when there is a game.
signup.whatsappHint: With area code, no leading 0 or 15
signup.consent: I agree that {club} stores my data (first name, last name, gender, category, playing position, availability, phone number and, if I add it, Instagram) and uses it to contact me by WhatsApp or phone with invitations to matches, court slots, tournaments and leagues.
signup.consentInfo:
Data controller: {club}. Platform: PadelHub, developed by Duxio, which processes the data on behalf of the club.
Purpose: organizing the club's matches and events and contacting you to invite you. Your data is not sold or shared with other clubs or third parties.
Providing your data is optional, and you can ask at any time to access, correct or delete it by writing to the club.
signup.consentInfoAr: In Argentina, data subjects may exercise their right of access free of charge at intervals of no less than six months (art. 14, para. 3, Law 25.326). The Agency for Access to Public Information, the supervisory body for Law 25.326, handles complaints about non-compliance with personal data protection rules.
signup.doneBody: You are now in {club}'s player list. The club will message you on WhatsApp when there is a game for you.
signup.existsBody: This phone number is already in {club}. We did not change your details.
signup.existsHelp: If something changed, like your category or availability, let the club know and they will update it.
